description: Exercise zero occupied power, empty-band fallback, no detected peaks, first-maximum selection, and the default respiratory-frequency floor.

oracle.description: Zero total power gives NaN occupied limits, so the full spectrum is restored. The flat spectrum has no peaks and its first maximum is f = 0 Hz; the default floor changes this to 0.1 Hz, giving delay = round(2 * 0.2 / 0.1) = 4.
